Tests structured extraction via liter-llm with JSON schema

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput, ExtractionConfig, LlmConfig, StructuredExtractionConfig, ExtractInputKind

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput(kind=ExtractInputKind("uri"), uri="https://example.com/pdf/fake_memo.pdf")
    config = ExtractionConfig(structured_extraction=StructuredExtractionConfig(llm=LlmConfig(model="openai/gpt-4o"), schema={"properties": {"date": {"type": "string"}, "summary": {"type": "string"}, "title": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["title"], "type": "object"}, schema_name="memo_data", strict=True))
    result = await extract(input, config)
    print(result.results[0].structured_output)

asyncio.run(main())
```
